The night he could not sleep
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-21 for ken-shorts s31 (VTT 01:01:07 to 01:01:44); re-read 2026-11-22; the twin r21a carries it
segments.quote_anchor: my existential moment was when my dad, who trusted me beyond all reason ... I had his entire retirement account in a position because I thought it was going to go up tomorrow ... I've got more than 100 percent of his retirement in that position and I couldn't sleep the rest of the night, and what I learned was that I have to make long-term decisions based on my pessimistic nature
segments.why: The custodian-of-the-family beat in his own life, and the reason he became systematic. Nothing we could write would carry it.

segments.toc_title: I don't try to eliminate the monkey
segments.status: MINED 2026-11-22 (VTT 01:03:57 to 01:04:23; cue 3837.0 'Lesson learned was not so much this system versus that system', cue 3860.8 ends 'helped me with risk' before 'I see a question'); the twin r31a carries it
segments.quote_anchor: Lesson learned was not so much this system versus that system, but really to accommodate the internal dialogue and the emotional nature of trade. I don't try to eliminate the monkey. The monkey is the source of my inspirations and intuitions. Most of them don't work, but some of them do. And so finding a way to cherish and accommodate that helped me with risk.
segments.why: The anti-hype rung: a teacher who says most of his own ideas don't work. The line growogtx's clip assessment called the best in the tape.
